title: Measurement Induced Subradiance
summary: Preparing subradiant steady states of collectively emitting quantum two-level emitters (TLEs) is hindered by their dark, weakly interacting nature. Existing approaches rely on patterned driving, local control, or structured environments. We propose a platform-independent protocol based on projective measurements on a single TLE. For permutation-symmetric ensembles, a single measurement yields appreciable occupation of single-excitation subradiant steady states.
